findings.title: Kube client private key committed
findings.problem: Commit b199c4783 adds .kube-local/kubeconfig.yaml and kubeconfig-internal.yaml containing client-certificate-data and client-key-data (EC private key, system:masters-style local cluster credentials). Not gitignored and unrelated to the script-step feature.
findings.impact: Cluster-admin credential material enters git history and any MR or clone.
findings.recommendation: Remove both files from the branch history, add .kube-local/ to .gitignore, and rotate the embedded client key and certificate if the cluster is reachable.

findings.title: Epic spec 7.5 edits not made
findings.problem: The spec requires two line edits to epic architecture spec section 7.5 (residual risk; PROJECT-settings row now closed only for tools outside the list). The file is unchanged in the diff.
findings.impact: A required spec requirement is unmet; the epic spec still describes the pre-change risk posture.
findings.recommendation: Apply the two line edits to section 7.5 of architecture-spec.md.

findings.title: No test for treat_as_global on update/validate
findings.problem: update_workflow (~697) and validate_workflow (~768) pass treat_as_global=bool(is_global) to _consumer_slot_warnings, but only the create route (and publish) has a test asserting the collector receives it.
findings.impact: Dropping or inverting treat_as_global on save or validate would ship without a failing test, silently removing the warning that listed aliases run under the author's account for every user.
findings.recommendation: Add router tests for PUT /v1/workflows/{id} and the validate endpoint that patch collect_script_step_owner_integration_warnings and assert kwargs['treat_as_global'] == bool(proposed.is_global) and that the script-step warning is returned.

findings.title: callable_tools map has no generator/test-run consumer
findings.problem: ProjectScope.callable_tools returns the policy mapping, but grep of src shows no consumer; the script generator and test run are not shown to offer or accept only the tools of the step map (story AC partial).
findings.impact: Story criterion that test run and generator are limited to the step's map is not met in this change; authors can be offered tools the runtime then refuses.
findings.recommendation: Wire the generator and test-run tool offering to scope.callable_tools(), with a test; if they live in another ticket, record that in the task and spec.
